title: Extended Level 5 Diploma in Management
description: Develop a broad foundation in management, economics, society, technology, sustainability, communication, and professional practice for effective organisational leadership.
longDescription: This Extended Level 5 in Management provides learners with a broad and interdisciplinary understanding of management and the wider social, economic, political, and cultural environment. The programme develops knowledge of economics, mathematics, political science, psychology, sociology, history, cultural studies, and sustainable development. Learners also develop practical competencies in information and communication technologies, foreign languages, communication, and professional practice. The programme encourages learners to understand how economic, social, technological, environmental, and cultural factors influence organisations and management decisions. Through academic and practical learning, learners develop the knowledge and transferable skills required for further study and progression into management-related roles. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
courseDetails: Analyse key historical, cultural, social, political, economic, and environmental factors that influence organisations and management practices. Apply fundamental microeconomic and macroeconomic concepts and mathematical principles to business and management decision-making. Evaluate the role of sustainability, ecology, life safety, and responsible development in organisational and societal contexts. Demonstrate effective use of information and communication technologies and communication skills in academic, professional, and organisational environments. Assess organisational and human behaviour using relevant concepts from psychology, sociology, cultural studies, and political science. Demonstrate professional, interpersonal, practical, and transferable skills through educational practice and preparation for further academic and professional development. entry: Extended Level 5 Diploma In Management, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
progression: Upon completing the Extended Level 5 Diploma In Management students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
